association_citations.quote:
2.1. Preparation of the functional electrolytes and batteries
EC, EMC, and sodium flurophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), sodium difluorophosphate (NaDFP) provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The electrolyte was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in a mixture of EC: EMC = 3:7, and this electrolyte was assigned as baseline electrolyte. NaDFP was added to the baseline electrolyte to prepare. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd and Hard Carbon were purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. Pouch cells were assembled using an NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1C), a hard carbon (HC, 290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05C) anode, and a Celgard 2700 membrane as the separator. NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid were dispersed in N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The areal loading of the anode and cathode was 16 g m $^{-2}$ and 33 g m $^{-2}$ , respectively. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were first prepared, and then stacked with 10 cathode electrodes by 11 anode electrodes and packaged in a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. The resultant pouch cell was dried under vacuum at 80 °C for 72 h before being moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte. The size of prepared pouch cells was 52 mm × 5 mm × 100 mm.

## 配方筛选结果
获得文献支持的候选：cai-2024-1wt-nadfp、che-2021-0.8m-pc-emc。

### 候选资料：che-2021-0.8m-pc-emc（通过筛选）
以下为候选记录中的组成，配制时须核对所引原文的比例基准与用量。
盐：NaPF6；浓度：0.8 mol L⁻¹；NaPF6：0.8 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：PC, EMC；溶剂比例（体积）：PC=1.0, EMC=1.0；添加剂：FEC；添加剂用量：FEC=2 wt%。
- 配方原文 [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]：Therefore, in the present work, the PC/EMC solvent system was preferably selected to investigate the effect of solvent ratio and salt concentration. In the binary PC/EMC (1:1, v/v) system, the highest conductivity of 7.45 mS cm $^{-1}$ at 20 °C is observed at 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ (Fig. 1b). It is also found that the conductivity of electrolyte changes with the solvent ratio changing. The viscosity of 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolyte is gradually increased with the PC content rising. With an increase in the PC content, the conductivity increases markedly in the range lower than 40%, reaches a maximum at 60% (i.e., PC/EMC=3/2), and inversely declines in the range higher than 60% (Fig. 1c). On the other hand, the electrolytes with PC content lower than 40% are much easier to wet the nonpolar polypropylene-polyethylene separator. Complete wetting of the separator typically takes no more than 10 seconds, as indicated by the wetting angles and wettability in Fig. S1 and Fig. S2. Based on the above results, five 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolytes were prepared by using 2 wt% FEC additive and PC/EMC, PC/DMC, EC/EMC, EC/DMC and EC/DEC mixed solvents (all having a 2:3 cyclic/linear carbonate ratio), respectively. It is shown that the ionic conductivity of these electrolytes is increased in the order of EC/DMC > PC/DMC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > EC/DEC, whereas the viscosity is changed nearly in an opposite order of EC/DEC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > PC/DMC ≈ EC/DMC (Fig. 2a).

### 候选资料：cai-2024-1wt-nadfp（通过筛选）
以下为候选记录中的组成，配制时须核对所引原文的比例基准与用量。
盐：NaPF6；浓度：0.8 mol L⁻¹；NaPF6：0.8 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：EC, EMC；溶剂比例（基准待核对）：EC=0.3, EMC=0.7；添加剂：NaDFP；添加剂用量：NaDFP=1 wt%。
- 配方原文 [0002_Cai 等 - 2024 - A dual-functional electrolyte additive for stabilizing the solid electrolyte interphase and solvatio::sec4]：2.1. Preparation of the functional electrolytes and batteries
EC, EMC, and sodium flurophosphate (NaPF $_6$ ), sodium difluorophosphate (NaDFP) provided by the Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co, Ltd. The electrolyte was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in a mixture of EC: EMC = 3:7, and this electrolyte was assigned as baseline electrolyte. NaDFP was added to the baseline electrolyte to prepare. All electrolytes were prepared in a dry argon filled glove box with both moisture and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm. NFM was purchased from Jiangsu Xiangying New Energy Technology Co, Ltd and Hard Carbon were purchased from Kuraray Co Ltd. Pouch cells were assembled using an NFM cathode (120 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.1C), a hard carbon (HC, 290 mAh g $^{-1}$ at 0.05C) anode, and a Celgard 2700 membrane as the separator. NFM active material, polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF), carbon nanotube (CNT), conductive carbon black (Super P), and Maleic acid were dispersed in N-methylpyrrolidone (NMP) with a mass ratio of 94.5:1.8:1:2.5:0.2, and the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The HC active material, sodium carboxymethyl cellulose (CMC), styrene-butadiene rubber (SBR), and conductive carbon black (Super P) with a mass ratio of 95:1.5:2:1.5 were mixed and dispersed in water, and then the slurry was coated on an aluminum substrate. The areal loading of the anode and cathode was 16 g m $^{-2}$ and 33 g m $^{-2}$ , respectively. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were first prepared, and then stacked with 10 cathode electrodes by 11 anode electrodes and packaged in a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. The resultant pouch cell was dried under vacuum at 80 °C for 72 h before being moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte. The size of prepared pouch cells was 52 mm × 5 mm × 100 mm.

## 候选评估
### che-2021-0.8m-pc-emc
评估建议：The candidate (0.8 M NaPF6, PC/EMC 1:1 v/v, 2 wt% FEC) matches the paper's PC/EMC pouch-cell electrolyte, which has directly reported -30 C capacity retention in NFM/HC pouch cells, supporting it as the recommended electrolyte for the -30 C program; no separate computed prediction is available, and the exact 0.8 M vs 1 M attribution of the -30 C figure should be confirmed against Fig. S5.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Target system must be a sodium-ion pouch cell：The paper explicitly evaluates Ah-level NFM/HC sodium-ion pouch cells with these carbonate electrolytes, matching the pouch-cell program context. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec2::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5]
- Salt must be NaPF6：The study uses NaPF6 as the solute throughout the PC/EMC electrolyte work. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec2::child0]
- Salt concentration must be 0.8 mol/L：The paper reports 0.8 M NaPF6 electrolytes as the studied concentration in the PC/EMC system. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8]
- Solvent system must be PC/EMC：The work selects PC/EMC as the base solvent system for the optimized electrolyte. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec9::child0]
- PC/EMC ratio of 1:1 by volume：The paper uses PC/EMC (1/1, v/v) as the baseline this study builds on; note that the later five-electrolyte comparison used a 2:3 cyclic/linear ratio, so the 1:1 base and the comparison set are not identical formulations. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- FEC additive at 2 wt%：The paper states the five 0.8 M NaPF6 electrolytes were prepared using 2 wt% FEC additive, matching the candidate's additive package. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- Quantified capacity retention relative to room temperature at -30 C：Low-temperature retention for the PC/EMC pouch cell is reported (72.7% at -30 C in one passage; 74.40% at -30 C quoted for the 1 M PC/EMC cell, with 0.8 M noted as slightly lower), which directly addresses the -30 C retention observable; exact attribution between 0.8 M/1 M formulations should be checked against Fig. S5. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5]
文献与候选的关联：In this study the NaPF6/carbonate electrolytes were applied to NFM/HC pouch cells, and low-temperature capacity retention was measured on those same pouch cells: the PC/EMC electrolyte cell retained 72.7% at -30 C (with a 1 M PC/EMC cell reported at 74.40% at -30 C), so the composition and the -30 C retention observable are experimentally associated in the same pouch-cell system rather than inferred across systems. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
### che-2021-1m-pc-emc
评估建议：Literature directly measures the candidate 1 M NaPF6/PC-EMC electrolyte in NFM/HC pouch cells with 74.40% capacity retention at -30 °C relative to room temperature, satisfying the target observable; the only open point is whether that specific reported cell was fully additive-free.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte salt/solvent identity: NaPF6 in PC/EMC (1:1 v/v) carbonate mixture：The source states the PC/EMC (1/1, v/v) system was selected with NaPF6 as solute, establishing the solvent/salt pairing of the candidate. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- 1.0 M NaPF6 salt concentration in the PC/EMC electrolyte：A 1 M NaPF6 PC/EMC electrolyte is explicitly tested and its low-temperature profiles reported, matching the candidate concentration. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5]
- Pouch-cell (NFM/hard-carbon) device format：The electrolyte was evaluated in Ah-level NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2/hard-carbon pouch cells, and the PC/EMC low-temperature retention is reported for NFM/HC pouch cells. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec2::child0][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4]

[0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4]

[0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec9::child0]
文献与候选的关联：The candidate identity (NaPF6/PC-EMC carbonate electrolyte) is tied to the paper's pouch-cell low-temperature measurements: the 1 M NaPF6 PC/EMC cell's discharging profiles and capacity retentions at -20/-30/-40 °C, reported as fractions of room-temperature capacity, provide the -30 °C retention directly. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4]
### li-2025-3wt-tmss
评估建议：The candidate reproduces the paper's demonstrated all-climate pouch SIB electrolyte (NaPF6 1.0 M, EC:EMC 3:7 wt%, 3 wt% TMSS) and -30 °C pouch-cell discharge is directly reported, so the literature supports recommending this candidate; the only gap is that the metric is reported as absolute -30 °C capacities and baseline-relative improvement rather than an explicit room-temperature-normalized retention ratio.

- Salt identity and concentration: NaPF6 at 1.0 mol/L.：Methods state NaPF6 dissolved in the EC/EMC mixture to prepare a 1 mol/L baseline electrolyte, matching the candidate salt and concentration. - Solvent composition EC:EMC = 3:7 by mass.：The preparation section gives EC:EMC = 3:7 in wt.%, identical to the candidate's mass-based ratio and basis. [0030_Li 等 - 2025 - An electrolyte design strategy for commercial all-climate pouch sodium-ion batteries::sec4::child0]

### li-2025-1wt-tmsbs
评估建议：The candidate matches the paper's functional pouch-cell electrolyte (NaPF6 1 M, EC:EMC 3:7 wt%, 1 wt% TMSBS) and is directly demonstrated to discharge at -30 °C with higher capacity than baseline, supporting its selection for the -30 °C pouch SIB program; the only caveat is that the -30 °C value is reported as absolute mAh and a baseline comparison rather than a room-temperature-referenced retention, so that exact metric remains to be confirmed.

## 下一步核查与验证
- 在目标软包电芯（NFM/HC 或项目实际正负极对）上以 0.5C/1C 放电测 -30 °C 相对 25 °C 容量的保持率，作为主观测量的端到端验证；文献已给出 PC/EMC 体系 72.7%（0.8 M 筛选体系）与 74.40%（1 M 体系）两种实测值，需在项目电芯上复核。
- 确认 Che 2021 中 0.8 M NaPF6 / PC-EMC 所用“第二代添加剂”的完整清单与用量（原文仅在结论中提及），因为 -30 °C 保持率结论绑定在该完整配方上。
- 对 0.8 M NaPF6 + 1 wt% NaDFP / EC:EMC (3:7) 体系补测相对 25 °C 容量的 -30 °C 放电保持率；文献仅以 688 mAh（1C）与基线 459 mAh 报告，缺少室温基准容量。
- 对 TMSS（3 wt%）与 TMSBS（1 wt%）体系补取同批电芯的 25 °C 放电容量，以把已报告的 -30 °C 放电容量（793 mAh / 814 mAh @0.5C）换算为相对室温容量的保持率。
- 补取 0.5 M NaPF6 G2/DOL 的 G2:DOL 比例，并区分“-30 °C 循环保持率”与“-30 °C 相对室温容量保持率”两项不同指标。
- 在近似与目标工况下评估安全性/产气与成本：本项目未提供价格数据，文献仅给出低成本动机，不得据此宣称已验证低成本。
